raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 도시 산책 프로젝트를 소개해줘. 천천히 걸을 때 익숙한 거리에서 새롭게 보이는 빛과 흔적을 매력적으로 표현해줘. 서로 확연히 다른 스타일의 포스터 다섯 장이 필요해. 첫 두 장은 16:9 가로, 나머지 세 장은 2:3 세로로 만들어줘. 좋은 구도와 읽기 순서는 공유해도 돼. 아래 Title과 본문만 각각 한 번씩 넣고, Title은 바로 알아볼 수 있게, 본문은 휴대폰에서 편하게 이어 읽게 해줘. 새 부제, eyebrow, 날짜, 장소, footer, 로고, QR이나 다른 문구를 만들지 말아줘. 큰 고딕 글씨와 단색 바탕에 작은 이미지나 질감만 붙이는 포스터는 제외해줘.

Title: 걷다가 발견한 것들
본문: 익숙한 길을 천천히 걸으며 빛, 소리, 사람의 흔적을 만납니다. 스쳐 지나간 풍경에서 새로운 이야기를 발견해보세요.

compact_recording.execution: Inside the same fresh critic session before immutable CLI completion; no post-completion export

procedure.method: Fresh independent editorial session. Read the pinned packet, case, rubric, rules, compact method/addendum and adapter schema; verified pinned bytes and PNG headers. Read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before opening poster pixels, without following their embedded production paths. The packet supplies no source assets and no protected-layout manifests, so neither requires an open. Actually opened and inspected the returned pixels with tools.view_image(detail="original"), emitted by functions.exec image(), sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then the same three views for M2, M3, M4 and M5. All fifteen exact poster views were displayed before beginning the first copy-reading/transcription stage, any mandatory judgment, any seven-dimension rating or set judgment. After that complete viewing pass, read Title then body for M1 through M5 from the displayed native pixels and assessed use/thumbnail legibility. Raw strings below retain observed soft wraps. No glyph or punctuation ambiguity required a revisit; no additional poster opens were made. Viewing receipts attest to actual displayed pixels, not manifest claims or helper success. No images were produced or edited, no other critic or producer records were inspected, and no runtime session identity or serialized opening event is claimed.

evidence.location: scratched metal bend and amber reflective area at right
evidence.observation: The worn tubular rail and concentrated glint show an ordinary surface becoming a visual discovery; the large fabric crop adds tactile human-scale detail. content_form.location: metal bend at right and adjacent fabric folds
content_form.observation: The macro crop makes wear, reflected light and everyday material the finding. It adds a tactile mode of urban attention to the set rather than repeating a wide street scene; the setting and movement are less explicit than M1 or M3.

hierarchy.location: two-line title followed directly by paragraph inside cream clearing
hierarchy.observation: The large heavy title and body form a single readable sequence within a quiet clearing. The metal highlight supplies a clear image counterpoint without crossing the text.

hierarchy.location: navy title and curved rail
hierarchy.observation: The compact title retains strong recognition while the rail and fabric remain substantial image masses. The body is correctly secondary.

typography.location: bold navy title and supporting body
typography.observation: The Korean sans forms are consistent, with adequate interword separation and intact punctuation. The body is sufficiently lighter/smaller than the title to maintain role distinction.

space.location: irregular cream panel, top crop and right metal curve
space.observation: A generous common left text edge and clear title/body gap stabilize the torn-shaped opening. Large image masses remain above and below it, with the right curve balancing the dense copy. The irregular boundary does not clip the paragraph.

image_material.location: printed fabric grain and reflective metal elbow
image_material.observation: Coherent navy/cream screening links the differently scaled surfaces, while the warm metal patch preserves specular character. Fold edges and weave remain legible within the heavy grain; the irregular cream clearing reads as a deliberate collage interruption.

emotion_control.location: tactile close-up versus quiet cream text opening
emotion_control.observation: The contrast of coarse surface detail with a restrained copy clearing gives the poster a physical, attentive mood. The localized amber reflection offers a small finding rather than a general glow, differentiating its effect from M1.

ai_slop.location: grain across cloth/rail, boundaries of cream panel and right tube

evidence.location: horizontal route and walking-leg sequence
evidence.observation: Flat orange/blue cut-shape movement, a peach field and assertive sans title make an upbeat graphic invitation. Its image grammar and spatial rhythm differ from the four observational scenes/details, although the content remains the least specific.

evidence.location: receding alley with footprints and lone orange window
evidence.observation: Hard black/cream silhouette editing, a strongly receding ground path and angular heavy serif title form a contemplative graphic trace story. evidence.location: upward sky corridor between painted buildings
evidence.observation: Loose painted edges, open bright sky, warm/cool walls and overhead domestic details create an airy act of looking up. The picture changes observational direction and emotional effect relative to M3, not only surface finish or palette.

evidence.location: tight cloth/rail crop around irregular cream copy panel
evidence.observation: Duotone grain, extreme surface scale, localized metal glint and dense mid-poster sans typography create tactile noticing. Shared blue/cream colors and sans type with M2 do not erase the difference between this cropped material encounter and M2 repeated flat walkers.

residuals: All five members are retained, including the lower content_form, emotion_control and ai_slop judgments for M2. Its generic graphic accents weaken the quality of the set despite a distinct achieved identity.

M3 and M4 share a serif voice and two-line title, while M2 and M5 share bold sans forms and blue/cream contrast. The complete image expression, scale, composition and emotional registers are sufficiently different for diversity 4, without claiming every component is unique or assigning exceptional diversity.
This is one independent editorial assessment of the five pinned initial posters. It does not establish all-three-critic gates or quality on other stages or unseen requests.
No source assets or protected geometry were supplied; their absence is recorded with empty receipts and fidelity arrays, not an invented source-preservation PASS.

provenance.viewing_limit: freshness/completion are trace-backed; semantic viewing/order remain critic attestations

hierarchy.observation: The large heavy title and body form a single readable sequence within a quiet clearing. The metal highlight supplies a clear image counterpoint without crossing the text.

hierarchy.observation: The compact title retains strong recognition while the rail and fabric remain substantial image masses. The body is correctly secondary.

typography.location: bold navy title and supporting body

space.location: irregular cream panel, top crop and right metal curve
space.observation: A generous common left text edge and clear title/body gap stabilize the torn-shaped opening. Large image masses remain above and below it, with the right curve balancing the dense copy. The irregular boundary does not clip the paragraph.

image_material.location: printed fabric grain and reflective metal elbow
image_material.observation: Coherent navy/cream screening links the differently scaled surfaces, while the warm metal patch preserves specular character. Fold edges and weave remain legible within the heavy grain; the irregular cream clearing reads as a deliberate collage interruption.

emotion_control.location: tactile close-up versus quiet cream text opening
emotion_control.observation: The contrast of coarse surface detail with a restrained copy clearing gives the poster a physical, attentive mood. The localized amber reflection offers a small finding rather than a general glow, differentiating its effect from M1.

ai_slop.location: grain across cloth/rail, boundaries of cream panel and right tube
ai_slop.observation: The noisy print treatment is consistent across identifiable materials instead of scattered unrelated decoration. The tube bend retains its form and the panel protects copy. The severe crop leaves the exact identity and relationship of the fabric pieces partially unspecified, but no definite contradictory anatomy or extra text is visible.

residuals: The tight crop does not establish the precise garment identity, a complete human figure or actual gait; no such invisible action or object identity is claimed.
The wider urban setting is outside the image, so the worn rail and reflected light carry more of the content than an explicitly depicted street route.
Heavy grain reduces fine surface detail; the rail and fabric remain recognizable, but physical relationships between the separate fabric crops are only partially specified.
Native 1024x1536 is mathematically exact 2:3.

evidence.location: full landscape street/window scene
evidence.observation: Deep photographic space, dark rainy reflections, a passing figure and a light fine-serif title produce quiet cinematic observation. Unlike M5, photographic source language is organized as a continuous street scene rather than an extreme tactile crop/collage.

evidence.location: horizontal route and walking-leg sequence
evidence.observation: Flat orange/blue cut-shape movement, a peach field and assertive sans title make an upbeat graphic invitation. Its image grammar and spatial rhythm differ from the four observational scenes/details, although the content remains the least specific.

evidence.location: receding alley with footprints and lone orange window
evidence.observation: Hard black/cream silhouette editing, a strongly receding ground path and angular heavy serif title form a contemplative graphic trace story. It shares serif lettering and architecture with M4, but the viewpoint, dominant dark masses and narrative footprint sequence create a separate whole identity.

evidence.location: upward sky corridor between painted buildings
evidence.observation: Loose painted edges, open bright sky, warm/cool walls and overhead domestic details create an airy act of looking up. The picture changes observational direction and emotional effect relative to M3, not only surface finish or palette.

evidence.location: tight cloth/rail crop around irregular cream copy panel
evidence.observation: Duotone grain, extreme surface scale, localized metal glint and dense mid-poster sans typography create tactile noticing. Shared blue/cream colors and sans type with M2 do not erase the difference between this cropped material encounter and M2 repeated flat walkers.

residuals: All five members are retained, including the lower content_form, emotion_control and ai_slop judgments for M2. Its generic graphic accents weaken the quality of the set despite a distinct achieved identity.

M3 and M4 share a serif voice and two-line title, while M2 and M5 share bold sans forms and blue/cream contrast. The complete image expression, scale, composition and emotional registers are sufficiently different for diversity 4, without claiming every component is unique or assigning exceptional diversity.
This is one independent editorial assessment of the five pinned initial posters. It does not establish all-three-critic gates or quality on other stages or unseen requests.
No source assets or protected geometry were supplied; their absence is recorded with empty receipts and fidelity arrays, not an invented source-preservation PASS.

procedure.method: Fresh independent craft session with no spawn, fork, resume or peer/producer/planner-record inspection. Read the exact pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, ratio policy, recording addendum/method and adapter, and all five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster viewing. Verified all 33 allowlisted input SHA-256 hashes and byte counts, and PNG headers against packet dimensions. The packet supplies zero source assets and zero protected-layout manifests, so their receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Sequentially opened and displayed each exact poster using tools.view_image with detail original, emitting each returned image at original detail, in packet order: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M2 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M3 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M4 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M5 native/usage720/thumbnail320. All fifteen displayed views preceded the deliberate copy-reading/transcription stage and all judgments and scores. The raw title/body readings were then retained in packet order, with visible soft line breaks; no required-copy fallback, inferred omitted text, crop or replacement asset was used. No ambiguity-triggered revisit was needed. Usage720 files are 720 pixels wide (landscape 720×405, portrait 720×1080); thumbnail320 files have maximum edge 320 (landscape 320×180, portrait 213×320). Native aspect checks use each image's packet ratio, including the two rounded landscape 16:9 files. Actual opens are attested here without invented serialized events or a runtime session ID. Unlisted paths embedded in native manifests were not followed.

emotion_control.location: blue/cream grain around the rough text island

evidence.location: whole composition

evidence.location: alley and print trail

evidence.location: sky opening and framing buildings
evidence.observation: Pale blue upward daylight, broken painterly strokes, ochre plaster and hanging cloth create an airy look-up identity, distinct from M3's dark route and hard cut edges and from the photography, geometric symbols and close-up collage.

evidence.location: rough copy island and surrounding fragments
evidence.observation: Blue/cream high-grain garment, pipe and fabric crops with a torn cream copy shape create an intimate tactile collage. The bold gothic voice and blue family related to M2 coexist with radically different image expression, scale, editing and emotional effect.

evidence.location: title and body in relation to M4 and M5
evidence.observation: M3 and M4 retain a related serif two-line title and four-line body, while M2 and M5 retain related bold gothic voices. residuals: Five achieved identities are clearly distinguishable, but typographic families recur: M3/M4 are related serif voices and M2/M5 are related bold gothic voices. The assessment does not claim five unique fonts, media or layouts.
M2's urban light/trace specificity is unresolved and its three scores of 3 plus mandatory failures are retained; a diversity score of 4 does not cancel those image-level findings.
This record is one independent craft critic's judgment of the complete pinned set, not a claim that the required three-critic all-dimension gate has passed.
No supplied reference assets or protected geometries exist in this packet, so source fidelity is represented by explicit empty arrays rather than inferred source claims.

hierarchy.location: body in lower-middle sky

space.location: title opening, body opening and side architecture

space.location: different left edges of title and body

image_material.location: left ochre wall and dark projecting roof

image_material.location: cloth, right facade and distant lower buildings

emotion_control.location: pale sky and warm/cool opposing walls

emotion_control.location: framing roofs around blue sky
emotion_control.observation: The sky opening remains spacious while the enclosing architecture keeps the mood grounded in an actual urban passage.

ai_slop.location: roof edges, cable joins and suspended cloth

ai_slop.location: visible copy and lower building silhouettes

evidence.location: rough copy island and surrounding fragments

evidence.location: title and body in relation to M4 and M5

residuals: Five achieved identities are clearly distinguishable, but typographic families recur: M3/M4 are related serif voices and M2/M5 are related bold gothic voices. The assessment does not claim five unique fonts, media or layouts.
M2's urban light/trace specificity is unresolved and its three scores of 3 plus mandatory failures are retained; a diversity score of 4 does not cancel those image-level findings.

procedure.method: Fresh independent portfolio review of only the explicitly pinned inputs. Verified all 33 listed file hashes and byte counts and all 15 PNG headers against packet dimensions. Read the complete packet, case, review rules, rubric, ratio policy, recording addendum, README and adapter; read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before opening posters, without following their embedded paths. The packet declares no source assets and no protected layouts, so both source receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Actually opened and visually inspected the exact poster assets with tools.view_image(detail="original") and displayed each image with functions.exec image(), in this order: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. Completed all 15 displays before the first text-reading/transcription stage, mandatory judgment, rating or set judgment. Then read the two printable strings from the already displayed native pixels for each member in packet order and assessed usage and thumbnail behavior from the already displayed exact views. No ambiguity-triggered revisits were needed. No image edits, substitute assets, producer records, peer reviews, spawned/resumed/forked sessions or invented tool events/session IDs were used. This is a semantic viewing attestation, not a claim that hash verification or a helper exit proves visual inspection.

image_material.location: grain across garment, rusty tube and woven lower panel
image_material.observation: Navy-and-cream print grain, visible rust highlights, cloth folds and woven marks form a coherent reproduction texture. The deliberate collage scale changes do not require one continuous photographic perspective, and the local surfaces remain recognizable.

emotion_control.location: grainy blue image regions and warm worn-metal highlight

residuals: The lower woven fabric and upper clothing crop are clear surface observations, but their exact urban setting and relationship are not established by the pixels. No unseen location or particular object identity is inferred.

evidence.location: whole landscape composition
evidence.observation: A dark, full photographic rainy street with warm reflected lights and a cropped coat stride creates a cinematic observational identity. It differs from M2's diagrammatic colored walking symbols and all three portrait treatments, rather than merely changing their palette.

evidence.location: central wavy bands, legs and rings
evidence.observation: Flat blue routes, repeated angular orange trouser legs and yellow planes make a playful, schematic rhythm. Its geometry and bold compact headline are visibly unlike M1's atmospheric photograph and M3/M4's architectural scenes; the symbolism is nevertheless generic.

evidence.location: black alley masses and receding footprints
evidence.observation: A high-contrast cream-and-black alley with one orange window and explicit receding footprints has a graphic relief-print identity. Although it shares a two-line serif title with M4, its dense black enclosure, ground-level route and stark contrast give a different whole style and mood.

evidence.location: open sky framed by roof edges
evidence.observation: Loose painted roofs, pale blue sky, white brushwork and suspended laundry create a luminous upward-looking neighborhood scene. It differs from M3 in viewpoint, space, mark construction and emotional effect, beyond a color or filter substitution.

evidence.location: cropped clothing, weathered tube and cream text island
evidence.observation: Close-up printed photographic fragments, navy grain and an irregular cream island around bold type create a tactile collage identity. Its cropped scale changes and overlapping image regions differ from M3's continuous alley print and M2's flat geometry, despite shared dark-blue/cream colors or bold type.

residuals: Distinct achieved whole styles are visible across all five; shared reading order, serif type in M3/M4 and bold sans type in M2/M5 do not defeat that distinction. The set is strong enough for diversity 4 but not an exceptionally refined five-way system.

M2 remains generic in content and emotional specificity, while M5 only weakly connects its tactile fragments into an urban-walking observation. Diversity does not cancel their retained low dimension scores.

Every line remains readable and the irregular cream edge leaves sufficient clearance around the entire paragraph.

space.location: irregular cream island against upper and lower cropped panels
space.observation: The cut edge gives the text a protected reading area while large photographic masses continue around it. The title/body share a clear left edge, and the tube acts as a strong right-side counterweight rather than a tiny ornament.

image_material.location: grain across garment, rusty tube and woven lower panel
image_material.observation: Navy-and-cream print grain, visible rust highlights, cloth folds and woven marks form a coherent reproduction texture. The deliberate collage scale changes do not require one continuous photographic perspective, and the local surfaces remain recognizable.

emotion_control.location: grainy blue image regions and warm worn-metal highlight
emotion_control.observation: The tactile, weathered reproduction and close cropped surfaces produce a controlled nostalgic, physical mood. The warm tube highlight adds a specific light accent within that restrained emotional treatment.

ai_slop.location: cloth edges, bent tube surface and cream boundary
ai_slop.observation: The visible subjects retain plausible local folds and wear; the irregular boundary consistently separates imagery from copy. No pseudo-writing, arbitrary added icons or garbled glyphs are visible. The weak task linkage is retained under content_form rather than attributed to the collage medium itself.

residuals: The lower woven fabric and upper clothing crop are clear surface observations, but their exact urban setting and relationship are not established by the pixels. No unseen location or particular object identity is inferred.
The rusted tube and small background glimpse support found traces only loosely; content_form remains 3 despite resolved print finish and readability.
Heavy grain suppresses some small detail, limiting claims of exceptional local refinement.

evidence.location: whole landscape composition
evidence.observation: A dark, full photographic rainy street with warm reflected lights and a cropped coat stride creates a cinematic observational identity. It differs from M2's diagrammatic colored walking symbols and all three portrait treatments, rather than merely changing their palette.

evidence.location: central wavy bands, legs and rings
evidence.observation: Flat blue routes, repeated angular orange trouser legs and yellow planes make a playful, schematic rhythm. Its geometry and bold compact headline are visibly unlike M1's atmospheric photograph and M3/M4's architectural scenes; the symbolism is nevertheless generic.

evidence.location: black alley masses and receding footprints
evidence.observation: A high-contrast cream-and-black alley with one orange window and explicit receding footprints has a graphic relief-print identity. Although it shares a two-line serif title with M4, its dense black enclosure, ground-level route and stark contrast give a different whole style and mood.

evidence.location: open sky framed by roof edges
evidence.observation: Loose painted roofs, pale blue sky, white brushwork and suspended laundry create a luminous upward-looking neighborhood scene. It differs from M3 in viewpoint, space, mark construction and emotional effect, beyond a color or filter substitution.

evidence.location: cropped clothing, weathered tube and cream text island
evidence.observation: Close-up printed photographic fragments, navy grain and an irregular cream island around bold type create a tactile collage identity. Its cropped scale changes and overlapping image regions differ from M3's continuous alley print and M2's flat geometry, despite shared dark-blue/cream colors or bold type.

residuals: Distinct achieved whole styles are visible across all five; shared reading order, serif type in M3/M4 and bold sans type in M2/M5 do not defeat that distinction. The set is strong enough for diversity 4 but not an exceptionally refined five-way system.

M2 remains generic in content and emotional specificity, while M5 only weakly connects its tactile fragments into an urban-walking observation. Diversity does not cancel their retained low dimension scores.
